definition: Among distinct products in the current rel_t window: share whose global first-sale date falls in the union of this window and the chronologically previous panel window (inclusive); leftmost pre uses current window only. Period-0 plot uses union of closure window and rel_t=-1 window.
executed_command: conda run -n JAX-py python src/displacement_effect_estimation/run.py --outcome variety_seeking --variety-seeking-mode distinct-only-new --output-dir outputs/displacement_effect_estimation/variety_seeking_distinct_only_new --log-file outputs/displacement_effect_estimation/variety_seeking_distinct_only_new/logs/run.log
